kebab_example: aliyun agency create-coupon-template --template-name '模板名称' --reason-for-application '模板申请原因' --cost-bearer Partner --applicable-products All_Products --limit-per-person Unlimited --value 1 --valid-until Validity_Duration --accept-language zh-CN --api-version 2022-12-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCouponTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The template name.
The field length is limited to 30 characters
parameters.help_zh:
【模板名称】
字段长度限制 30
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The reason for the template application.
The field length is limited to 100 characters
parameters.help_zh:
【模板申请原因】
字段长度限制100
parameters.name: reason_for_application

parameters.help_en:
The party that bears the coupon cost.
Partner: Borne by the partner.
Alibaba Cloud: Borne by Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
【优惠券成本承担方】
● Partner自行承担
● Alibaba Cloud阿里云承担成本
parameters.name: cost_bearer

parameters.help_en:
The applicable products.
All Products: All products.
Custom: Custom products
parameters.help_zh:
【适用产品】
● All Products全部产品
● Custom自定义
parameters.name: applicable_products

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of coupons that each person can claim.
Limited to 1: Limited to one coupon.
Unlimited: Unlimited
parameters.help_zh:
【每人限领张数】
● Limited to 1限领一张：
● Unlimited不限制
parameters.name: limit_per_person

parameters.help_en:
The denomination of the coupon.
The value must be an integer
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the coupon.
Validity Duration: From the date of issuance.
Custom Timeframe: Custom time period
parameters.help_zh:
【有效期】
● Validity Duration:自发券之日起
● Custom Timeframe:自定义时间段
parameters.name: valid_until

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the effective period.
Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
Example: 2024-08-26.  
This parameter is required when the validity period is set to Custom Timeframe
parameters.help_zh:
【生效时间的开始时间】
yyyy-MM-dd 格式
如 2024-08-26  
有效期选择 自定义时间段 必填
parameters.name: vailddate

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the effective period.
Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
Example: 2024-08-26.  
This parameter is required when the validity period is set to Custom Timeframe
parameters.help_zh:
【生效时间的结束时间】
yyyy-MM-dd 格式
如 2024-08-26  
有效期选择 自定义时间段 必填
parameters.name: expireddate

parameters.help_en:
The duration of the relative time in days.
The value must be a positive integer.
This parameter is required when the validity period is set to Validity Duration
parameters.help_zh:
【相对时间的持续多少天】
限制为正整数
有效期选择 自发券之日起 必填
parameters.name: vaildperioddays

parameters.help_en:
The remark for the coupon.
The field length is limited to 100 characters
parameters.help_zh:
券备注信息
长度限制100
parameters.name: coupon_description

parameters.help_en:
The accepted language.
Default value: None.
Valid values:
zh-CN: Chinese.
en-US: English.
ja: Japanese
parameters.help_zh:
默认值:无
    中文：zh-CN
    英文：en-US
    日文：ja
parameters.name: accept_language
